topBearNews.title: PL Q2 Deep Dive: Strong Revenue Driven by Defense, Guidance Falls Short of Expectations
topBearNews.summary: Earth imaging satellite company Planet Labs (NYSE:PL) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 58.1% year on year to $116.1 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $103 million was less impressive, coming in 10.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.02 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
